title: Agent Teams & Orchestration
brief: Multi-agent coordination for complex workflows using Claude's experimental agent teams feature. Design team topologies, implement forge/test/pipeline teams with 3 agents each, wire TeammateIdle hook for work reassignment, track team budgets, aggregate results, add cascade failure circuit breaker.

phases.title: Agent Team Infrastructure
phases.description: Design team topologies, define forge/test/pipeline teams, wire TeammateIdle hook, implement budget management, result aggregation, team dispatch skill, monitoring dashboard, integration tests, cascade failure handling, and outcome variability tracking.

units.title: Team topology design
units.rationale: Before implementing teams, the topology must be designed: which agents compose each team, their roles, model assignments, communication patterns, and escalation paths.
features: Team topology documentation for forge, test, and pipeline teams
exit_conditions: Topology documented in state/CCM-MS9/team-topology.json
Three teams defined: forge-team, test-team, pipeline-team
Each team has 3 agents with roles, models, and communication patterns

steps.instruction: Define forge-team: code-architect (Opus, planning), implementer (Sonnet, coding), physics-reviewer (Opus, validation).
Define test-team: test-runner (Haiku, execution), failure-analyzer (Sonnet, diagnosis), regression-reporter (Haiku, reporting).
Define pipeline-team: pipeline-planner (Sonnet, planning), executor (Sonnet, execution in worktree), verifier (Haiku, verification).
Document communication patterns: sequential handoff, parallel with merge, escalation to higher model.
Write topology to state/CCM-MS9/team-topology.json.

deliverables.description: Team topology definitions for all 3 teams

units.description: Team topology design — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Forge team definition
units.rationale: The forge team handles feature implementation: architect plans, implementer codes, reviewer validates physics correctness. This is the most critical team for PRISM development.
exit_conditions: Forge team defined with agent configs
Agent briefs specify role boundaries
Handoff protocol defined: architect→implementer→reviewer

steps.instruction: Create forge-team agent config: code-architect (Opus, Plan mode, reads specs/designs, outputs implementation plan).
Create implementer config (Sonnet, Code mode, reads plan, outputs code in worktree).
Create physics-reviewer config (Opus, Review mode, validates physics formulas, dimensional analysis, test coverage).
Define handoff protocol: sequential architect→implementer→reviewer with retry on review failure.

units.description: Forge team definition — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Test team definition
units.rationale: The test team handles quality assurance: runner executes suites, analyzer diagnoses failures, reporter produces regression reports. Uses cheaper models for execution tasks.
exit_conditions: Test team defined with agent configs
Runner uses Haiku for cost efficiency
Analyzer uses Sonnet for diagnostic depth

steps.instruction: Create test-runner config (Haiku, executes vitest, captures JSON output).
Create failure-analyzer config (Sonnet, reads failure output, diagnoses root cause, suggests fix).
Create regression-reporter config (Haiku, aggregates results, produces summary report).
Define handoff: runner→analyzer (on failures)→reporter (always).

units.description: Test team definition — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Pipeline team definition
units.rationale: The pipeline team handles end-to-end workflow execution: planner sequences operations, executor runs them in isolated worktrees, verifier confirms output correctness.
exit_conditions: Pipeline team defined with agent configs
Executor configured for worktree isolation
Verifier checks output against expected schema

steps.instruction: Create pipeline-planner config (Sonnet, reads milestone spec, produces execution plan with dependencies).
Create executor config (Sonnet, enters worktree, executes plan steps, exits worktree).
Create verifier config (Haiku, checks deliverables exist, validates exit conditions, runs relevant tests).
Define handoff: planner→executor→verifier with retry loop on verification failure.

units.description: Pipeline team definition — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: TeammateIdle hook
units.rationale: When an agent finishes its task early, TeammateIdle hook reassigns work from the backlog or pulls forward the next sequential task, maximizing agent utilization.
exit_conditions: Idle agents get new tasks from team backlog
Reassignment logged for tracking
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create TeammateIdle hook that fires when an agent completes its current task.
Check team backlog for pending tasks matching the idle agent's role.
Assign next eligible task or pull forward from sequence if dependencies met.
Log reassignment to state/CCM-MS9/team-activity.json.

units.description: TeammateIdle hook — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Team budget management
units.rationale: Each team should have a token budget to prevent runaway costs. SubagentStart hook tracks token spend per team and enforces caps.
features: Per-team token budget tracking and enforcement
exit_conditions: Budgets enforced per team
Spending tracked in state/CCM-MS9/team-budgets.json
Over-budget teams paused with warning

steps.instruction: Define budget caps per team: forge-team 500K tokens, test-team 200K tokens, pipeline-team 300K tokens.
Create SubagentStart hook that increments team spend counter.
At 80% budget, warn; at 100%, pause team and require human approval to continue.
Persist budgets to state/CCM-MS9/team-budgets.json.

deliverables.description: Team budget tracking and enforcement hook

units.description: Team budget management — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Team result aggregation
units.rationale: SubagentStop hook aggregates results from all team members into a unified report, making it easy to review what each agent accomplished and the overall team outcome.
exit_conditions: Unified reports produced per team run
Reports include per-agent output, timing, token spend, and success/failure
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create SubagentStop hook that captures agent output, timing, and token spend.
When all team members complete, merge results into unified report.
Write report to state/CCM-MS9/team-results/{team-name}-{timestamp}.json.
Include summary: pass/fail, total time, total tokens, per-agent breakdown.

units.description: Team result aggregation — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: /team-dispatch skill
units.rationale: A /team-dispatch skill provides a single-command interface to launch named teams with a brief, abstracting away the multi-agent coordination complexity.
entry_conditions: All team definitions and hooks complete
exit_conditions: Skill works: /team-dispatch forge-team 'implement feature X'
Skill validates team name and brief before launch
Skill returns team result summary on completion

steps.instruction: Create /team-dispatch skill that accepts team name and brief as arguments.
Validate team name against known topologies, validate brief is non-empty.
Launch team agents in sequence per handoff protocol.
Return aggregated result summary to caller.

units.description: /team-dispatch skill — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Team monitoring dashboard
units.rationale: Real-time team status via MCP resource enables monitoring active teams, agent states, progress, and budget without interrupting the workflow.
features: Real-time team status via MCP resource
entry_conditions: Budget tracking and result aggregation hooks working
exit_conditions: Status visible via MCP resource URI: prism://teams/status
Dashboard shows active teams, agent states, progress %, budget remaining
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create MCP resource template prism://teams/status that reads team activity and budget files.
Include per-team: active/idle/complete status, current agent, progress percentage, budget used/remaining.
Add prism://teams/{name}/history for past run results.
Test dashboard updates in real-time during a team run.

deliverables.description: MCP resource definition for team monitoring

units.description: Team monitoring dashboard — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Team integration tests
units.rationale: End-to-end integration test ensures forge-team can process a feature through all 3 agents (architect→implementer→reviewer) and produce a working result.
exit_conditions: End-to-end works: forge-team processes a small feature through all 3 agents
Test produces code, passes review, and generates test file
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Define a small test feature: add a utility function with JSDoc and test.
Launch forge-team via /team-dispatch with the feature brief.
Verify architect produces plan, implementer writes code, reviewer approves.
Confirm output files exist and tests pass.

units.description: Team integration tests — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Cascade failure circuit breaker
units.rationale: If an agent fails, blindly retrying wastes tokens. A circuit breaker evaluates P(recovery): abort if <0.3, retry with same model if 0.3-0.7, escalate to higher model if >0.7.
features: Cascade failure circuit breaker with P(recovery) evaluation
entry_conditions: TeammateIdle hook working, team activity logs available
exit_conditions: Cascade handled: failures evaluated with P(recovery)
P<0.3 aborts with error report
P 0.3-0.7 retries with same model
P>0.7 retries with higher model (Haiku→Sonnet→Opus)

steps.instruction: Define P(recovery) heuristic: based on error type (syntax=0.9, logic=0.5, timeout=0.3, OOM=0.1), retry count (decreases with each retry), and agent capability.
Implement circuit breaker in team orchestration: catch agent failure, compute P(recovery).
Route: P<0.3 abort and report, P 0.3-0.7 retry same model, P>0.7 escalate to higher model.
Log all decisions to state/CCM-MS9/circuit-breaker-log.json.

units.description: Cascade failure circuit breaker — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Team outcome variability tracker
units.rationale: Track quality score variance across team runs to identify unstable teams. High sigma indicates inconsistent results that need topology or prompt adjustments.
features: Quality score variability tracking across team runs
entry_conditions: At least one integration test completed
exit_conditions: Variability tracked: quality score mean and sigma per team
Unstable teams (sigma > threshold) flagged for review
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Define quality score rubric: code correctness (0-40), test coverage (0-20), physics accuracy (0-20), style compliance (0-10), token efficiency (0-10).
After each team run, compute quality score and append to history.
Calculate running mean and sigma per team.
Flag teams with sigma > 15 (out of 100) as unstable.
Write variability report to state/CCM-MS9/team-variability.json.

units.description: Team outcome variability tracker — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.
